posts.author: Truant99
posts.body: So I am working on some swimming stuff on my maps, and it's all working well. All my characters have a walking and swimming sprite sheet and they are set to transition between the two as they enter the water region. The problem is that as soon as the leading character touches the water tile, all the characters switch to the swimming animation even though they are still "on land." I've fixed this by having them clump up on entrance and exit to water, but that's a little awkward. Is there a way to have the characters transition one by one as they enter the water region? Thanks!

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
I assume you are using region or terrain ID to define what is deep water, shallow water, etc... I made a similar system a few years ago, but I don't have it working as a plugin, so I'll give you the methods:
Complete Tutorial Event + Sample video:
Followers walking in water (MV)
Hi! I managed to make a walking-in-water sprite work for the player as well as the follower when crossing a river, but the problem with how I made it is when the player steps in the water and the follower is still on land, the follower also gets the water sprite when he's not yet in the water...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Why did I use Javascript to change the follower graphics? Simple, to make the code dynamic and independent of the follower or the current sprite graphic it's using, so I wouldn't need to create dozens of
Conditional Branches
.
Player:
JavaScript:
$gamePlayer // Object
$gamePlayer.regionId() // Region ID
$gamePlayer._characterName // filename (String)
Check the number of members in the team, as attempting to modify objects that do not currently exist will cause errors in the game:
JavaScript:
$gameParty.members().length // Method with IF
Follower 1 (Party 2):
JavaScript:
$gamePlayer._followers.follower(0) // Object
$gamePlayer._followers.follower(0).regionId() // Region ID (Number)
$gamePlayer._followers.follower(0)._characterName // filename (String)
Follower 2 (Party 3):
JavaScript:
$gamePlayer._followers.follower(1) // Object
$gamePlayer._followers.follower(1).regionId() // Region ID (Number)
$gamePlayer._followers.follower(1)._characterName // filename (String)
Follower 3 (Party 4):
JavaScript:
$gamePlayer._followers.follower(2) // Object
$gamePlayer._followers.follower(2).regionId() // Region ID (Number)
$gamePlayer._followers.follower(2)._characterName // String

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
There's no need for double posting in a short period of time if your message can be edited...
Yes, it's much simpler than everything I've shown before. You'll know the actor's ID, and this simple number will be the pointer to all the data of that particular actor:
Just analyze this using F8 or F12:
Code:
$gameParty // return Object ({})
List:
JavaScript:
$gameParty._actors // return Array like [1,4,2,3]
Example:
JavaScript:
$gameParty._actors[0] // return 1 (ID in database)
Return name:
JavaScript:
$gameActors._data[$gameParty._actors[0]]._name // return String "Harold" (In a new project, if the player keeps him as the leader...)
